title: 第2章 租铺子
slug: 让我开早餐店我下午才营业
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

电动车的电量指示灯闪烁着最后一格红光。

范理把车停在了一个名叫“天玺”的小区外。

名字听着挺高大上，但大门外面的绿化带里杂草长得比人还高。小区临街是一整排商铺，全是灰蒙蒙的玻璃门。地上散落着水泥块和装修废料。旁边连个便利店都没有，只有两只野狗在垃圾桶旁边翻找。

玻璃门上贴着统一的红底黑字：旺铺招租。

范理按着上面的电话拨了过去。

“你好，哪位？”电话接通，对面传来嘈杂的麻将声。

“看铺子。天玺这边的。”

“哎哟！老板！你稍等，十分钟！马上到！”对面的麻将声瞬间停了，语气还有点激动。

毕竟这没什么人流量的铺子实在比较难租。

八分钟后，一个穿着白衬衫、夹着黑色皮包的中年胖子骑着一辆电动车，停在范理面前，从包里掏出一张皱巴巴的名片递过来。

“老板，久等了。我是这片的招商经理，姓王。叫我老王就行。”

范理没接名片，扫了一眼周围破败的环境说道，“王经理，你这旺铺挺低调啊。这地段，风水不好点估计连西北风都喝不饱。”

老王干笑两声，赶紧把名片塞回包里，顺手拉了拉紧绷的裤腰带道，“老板你这就不懂了，咱们做生意讲究个先发制人！你看这小区，虽然现在刚交房，入住率不高。但明后年，对面就要建小学。旁边还要通地铁！你现在租铺子，那是最明智的选择！等两年后，你这门槛都要被客流量踏破了！”

范理干了几年运营，天天给主播写话术，老王这点道行在他眼里也就那样。

“不是……王哥，规划局的地铁红头文件都没下，你在这儿跟我凭空建站呢？对面那个空地我刚才骑车看过了，是高压线塔，你家小学建高压线底下给学生做电疗啊？”范理没好气道。

老王脸上的笑容僵了一下，额头上渗出一层细汗，“这……那什么，老板你懂行，我也不忽悠你。咱们看铺子，看铺子。你要多大面积的？”

“便宜的。”范理回答得很干脆。

老王懂了，这小年轻没多少本钱。他掏出一大串钥匙，走到第一间双开门的大铺子前，哗啦啦拉起卷闸门。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The battery indicator light of the electric vehicle flashed the last red light.

Fan Li parked the car outside a community called "Tianxi".

The name sounds very noble, but the weeds in the green belt outside the gate are taller than people.Facing the street of the community is a row of shops, all with gray glass doors.Cement blocks and renovation debris were scattered on the ground.There wasn't even a convenience store nearby, just two wild dogs rummaging through the trash cans.

There are uniform black characters on a red background posted on the glass door: Prosperous Shop for Rent.

Fan Li pressed the number above and dialed.

"Hello, who's there?" The phone was connected, and the noisy mahjong sound came from the other side.

"Look at the shop. It's over here in Tianxi."

"Ouch! Boss! Just wait, ten minutes! I'll be there soon!" The mahjong sound on the other side stopped instantly, and his tone was still a little excited.

After all, it is difficult to rent a shop with little traffic.

Eight minutes later, a fat middle-aged man wearing a white shirt and carrying a black leather bag rode an electric bicycle and stopped in front of Fan Li. He took out a crumpled business card from his bag and handed it over.

"Boss, I've been waiting for a long time. I am the investment manager here, and my surname is Wang. Just call me Lao Wang."

Fan Li did not take the business card, but glanced at the dilapidated environment around him and said, "Manager Wang, this prosperous shop of yours is quite low-key. If the feng shui in this area is not good, even the northwest wind will not be enough."

Lao Wang laughed dryly and quickly stuffed his business card back into his bag. He tugged on his tight waistband and said, "Boss, you don't understand. We are very preemptive in doing business! Look at this community, although the housing has just been handed over, the occupancy rate is not high. But in the next year, a primary school will be built opposite. There will also be a subway next to it! If you rent a shop now, that is the wisest choice! In two years, your threshold will be crossed by the flow of customers!"

Fan Li has been working as an operator for several years and writes speeches for anchors every day. In his eyes, Lao Wang's ethics are just like that.

"No...Brother Wang, I haven't even downloaded the red-headed subway documents from the Planning Bureau. Why are you here with me building a station out of thin air? I just saw the open space across the street on my bike. It's a high-voltage power line tower. Is your elementary school going to build electrotherapy under the high-voltage power lines for students?" Fan Li said angrily.

The smile on Lao Wang's face froze, and a thin layer of sweat broke out on his forehead, "This...that, boss, you know your stuff, and I won't fool you. Let's look at the shop, look at the shop. How big an area do you want?"

"Cheap." Fan Li answered simply.

Lao Wang understands, this young man doesn’t have much capital.He took out a bunch of keys, walked to the first large shop with double doors, and pulled up the rolling shutters.
